text:
Erin (CSM): Quick kickoff for Hearthwell onboarding — pilot is targeted to start Mon Apr 7. Goal: get a production-ready inference pipeline for their search-assist feature. Need owners for infra (VPC/peering), SSO, prompts/quality, and enablement. Proposed success criteria below. Can folks pick owners and flag blockers? @Sam can you confirm contract/renewal constraints?

Sam (AE): Renewal hard date is 2026-11-01. Trial credits expire 2026-05-01. If adoption lags we'll hit renewal risk — I'll keep exec touchpoints scheduled.

Ryan (SE): I can own infra + health checks. Need region preference and VPC CIDR from Hearthwell. ETA for initial VPC peering + smoke test: 2026-04-09. I'll post logs here.

Priya (SE): I'll take SSO/SCIM. Please share SAML metadata and SCIM user list. Also — confirm if any PII flows through prompts or attachments. @Erin, does customer allow hashed IDs only?

Alan (Onboard Eng): Quick 30/60/90 draft: 
- 0-30: VPC peering + SSO, upload first prompt set, perf baseline
- 31-60: QoE tuning (prompt templates, batching), cost/quantization experiments
- 61-90: Roll out to 3 consumer teams, ops playbook and runbook handover
I'll slot dates once infra dates firm up.

Maria (Success Ops): I'll schedule a 45m enablement workshop week of 2026-04-14 and own the feedback survey. Will capture adoption signals + training gaps.

Erin (CSM): Proposed success criteria (initial):
- Integration: SSO + VPC established and verified
- Performance: p50 under 80ms, p99 under 400ms for common prompt (pilot traffic)
- Quality: eval set pass rate >= 90% on priority prompts (TBD)
- Adoption: 3 internal teams hitting ~1k reqs/day each by end of week 8
- Cost baseline: capture token-level cost and keep within PO expectations

Erin (CSM): Blockers right now: legal needs data-flow diagram and retention policy; product needs an eval set from Hearthwell. @Sam can you loop legal and get the doc? @Priya @Alan can you draft a basic eval set template for them to fill?

redwood-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.app/runbooks/hearthwell-onboard — checklist added:
```
- SSO configured
- VPC peering verified
- Perf smoke test passed
- Enablement scheduled
- Eval set uploaded
```

Ryan (SE): Copy — I'll post the healthcheck output here after peering test.

Priya (SE): I'll reach out to the customer for SAML metadata + confirm PII policy today.

Sam (AE): I'll coordinate the legal intro and schedule an exec touchpoint the week after enablement.

Erin (CSM): Great. If no major blockers by end of week I'll mark kickoff complete and create the first milestone in Jira (Onboard: Hearthwell - VPC + SSO). :thumbsup:
